title: Public meeting attendance, January–March 2026
summary: Attendance at three public meetings, retained as a small reproducible dataset for reporting and community review.
source: Sample Civic Clerk public meeting sign-in ledgers
methodology: Counts were transcribed from the public sign-in ledger after each meeting. Blank entries were not counted as attendees.
limitations: This demonstration dataset is small and does not measure unique people, remote attendance, or public interest outside recorded sign-ins.
definitions: Attendance means a completed entry on the public sign-in ledger.
